title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 4
paragraphs: Having designated Xerxes to the Persians as their king, Darius wished to proceed with his campaigns. But in the year after this, and after the Egyptian revolt, it fell out that Darius himself died, having been king for thirty-six years in all; and so he never managed to take vengeance either on the rebellious Egyptians or on the Athenians.
